Confused. So first off I love this app it’s my favorite! But a few things 1) When I had my Android phone I was able to use as a widget. That was the main reason I fell in love with it, besides all the cute stuff. I also bought most of everything except I had 2 refrigerators left. So then my daughter gave me her iPhone 8 Plus. So I got the app again but because it doesn’t have any account information like maybe a email with a password. So then I wouldn’t have had to re buy everything again, not fair I think. Another problem is I can’t figure out how to get the app to be a widget on my iPhone????? The whole point of having the app is to have the sticky notes on home screen to remind you of whatever is on note!!! Ya it’s also because it’s fun matching up each note with it’s agenda . Then using all of the cute stuff to make it stick out & grab your attention!! So could you please please help me out with the whole widget problem?? I’d really appreciate it & maybe you could look into the issue of having a account so if you switch cell phones you don’t loose your tools you’ve already paid for okay.. Thank you so very much. And you should know that your idea for this app came from a very talented & creative imagination. It’s for all ages definitely & if ya wanted to you could continue to add to it. Great Job!!

There isn’t a paid version.. You can purchase coins in the app so that you may purchase more magnets, backgrounds, etc. but you cannot purchase a version of the app without ads. (The ads are also unable to be closed.)

The ads take up the bottom portion of my memo space so that I cannot see the lower two notes. The ads are also unsightly.

I loved the app until the ads showed up this morning. (I downloaded the app, yesterday and there were no ads all day. To have them now feels like the developers are sneaky in throwing them in the day after one downloads the app.)

I would have purchased an ad-free version. I probably would have purchased in-app coins. I will be deleting the app, instead, since I don’t want to see ads. Ads are a cash grab when one already needs to purchase in app coins in order to use all of the features.

(One can play games in order to “earn” in app currency, which adds up slowly. I would rather pay for an ad-free version of this app versus have the developer double dip and receive money from ads AND in app currency purchases.)
